prompts.vesper:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original low-resolution game character sprite concepts on a genuinely transparent background.
Reference image 1 is the APPROVED blocky sprite style, not the character. Reference image 2 is Vesper's existing gear/silhouette design to preserve.
Create ONE horizontal row of THREE full-body Vesper concept sprites, widely separated, identical scale and same three-quarter RIGHT-facing relaxed boxing guard. No labels, no inset drawings, no ground shadows, no backdrop.
All three are the SAME HUMAN WOMAN: chestnut-brown wolf-cut hair, two real rectangular glasses lenses, visible human face, compact athletic street fighter. Neutral even lighting identical in all three. Clear connected head, torso, arms and legs. Readable at approximately 46 pixels head-to-foot, equipment can extend sideways. Simple thick blocky pixel clusters, 2-3 tones per material, clean silhouette, not high-detail illustration.
Left: Spark/base. Gunmetal cropped street-fighter jacket over a dark shirt, charcoal trousers, sneakers, subtle pale seams. Preserve the existing two asymmetric big chrome gauntlets: forward far gauntlet with orb sockets, near gauntlet at ribs with piston and plated knuckles. They are silver CHROME, not boxing gloves. Their design stays as reference 2.
Middle: Wanderer/middle rank. Same face/hair/glasses/body/gear, better structured gunmetal jacket with a short asymmetric shoulder panel and small fractured-glass-shaped clothing seams.
Right: highest Between Worlds #1. Same recognisable human face and glasses. Gunmetal and silver fitted clothing with pale violet/cyan fractured-glass seam details and a FEW compact suspended armour shards beside shoulders. Keep both original gauntlet designs; do not turn her into a robot or cover her face. No giant aura or independent combat VFX.
Authentic tiny chunky pixel art like reference 1. Do not draw a slender high-resolution fashion illustration or oversized head portrait. Entire feet visible. No painted glow haze.
prompts.isliid:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: three original tiny pixel-game Emperor Isliid body concept sprites, transparent.
Image 1 = approved simple blocky game style. Image 2 = OFFICIAL ORIGINAL Isliid Emperor appearance reference. Image 3 = OFFICIAL Beyond Fate Isliid appearance reference. Image 4 = current TFM2 scale/silhouette reference only.
Draw one horizontal row of THREE full-body sprites with generous transparent separation, identical body scale, three-quarter facing RIGHT, floating upright with lowered feet and composed imperial posture. No labels or ground shadow.
Same HUMAN Isliid Emperor in all 3: dark navy-black layered hair, pale face, piercing pale-cyan eye accent, white imperial tunic over navy, blue central jewel, gold seams/epaulets, dark gloves and boots, long navy-lined split coat. Capture his actual official face/hair/costume, not a generic crowned king. No crown, no blond hair.
Left = Bearer/base: canonical original white/navy/gold imperial outfit and floating posture from image 2, reduced to clean readable blocks.
Middle = Swordmaster: same body and face, layered tailored white coat and stronger navy panels, gold shoulder structure, restrained regent detail.
Right = Imperial #1/Beyond Fate direction from image 3: dark navy outer flowing coat with gold edging over ivory uniform, more elaborate collar and split tails, subtle lilac/blue eye and ascended trim. Human face still visible. Do not obscure with a helmet.
Pixel style of image 1: about 44 visible logical pixels tall per body, few large clean pixel clusters, restrained 2-tone shading, crisp outline, consistent even lighting, complete connected anatomy, not detailed anime painting.
Do NOT draw the flying swords or auras: they are independent existing game assets and will remain unchanged. No new weapons, no combat effects. Transparent around every body.
prompts.coder:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original tiny pixel-game human programmer rank concepts on transparent background.
Image 1 = APPROVED blocky game sprite style. Image 2 = current four bodies and stock Knight for context, not anatomy to repaint.
Create one horizontal row of THREE widely separated full-body sprites, SAME human programmer and consistent body scale, three-quarter facing RIGHT. No labels, no shadows, full shoes visible. Authentic simple chunky pixel clusters, strong outline, 2-3 shades, logical body height about 40-43 pixels, not detailed portrait art.
All three: dark tousled short hair, expressive recognisable human face, charcoal/graphite hoodie or tech jacket, dark trousers, light-soled shoes. Connected entire body, balanced feet. Hands held forward at waist in an expressive typing gesture. DO NOT draw a keyboard, as the game's existing keyboards will be retained separately.
Left = Script Kiddie/base: loose graphite hoodie with muted green drawstring detail, ordinary dark jeans, casual slightly leaning attentive programmer.
Middle = Senior: structured graphite zip jacket, violet seam accent, cleaner collar, same body/face/hair, more assured typing posture.
Right = Zero-Day #1: tailored black/graphite technological coat with muted gold keyline seams and a FEW compact holographic GARMENT panels beside the shoulders/forearm, all within a readable humanoid silhouette. Still ordinary human head/hands, no robot face or helmet, no full-screen code window.
Keep identical lighting, anatomy and physical scale across ranks. Make rank differences in clothing, not bigger bodies or huge auras. No green hair, no weapons, no independent code window effects.
